Full agentWhat this means

Hearth runs a small background app on the device. We can measure exact time used, block specific apps, and enforce time limits even off-network.

Network-onlyWhat this means

Hearth controls the device through your home network — we can block sites and pause Wi-Fi, but can't measure usage off the network and can't enforce time budgets reliably.
